notes.title: Tremors
notes.content:
Cave Update

You feel the Earth move, the floor beneath you groans and rumbles as if alive. You are certain that something below shifted, but what, or who, caused it?

The seismic event caused the Werewolf cave to collapse in on itself, revealing an elaborate cave system. 

The Werewolves now have a new home.

Before

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/e6efd29e81dab91a687b62b97a4c02573c2dc0f9.jpg

After

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/698cc75f9faf8aee2c950dd2e5ecdeed45c09497.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/c1e1481f5690096739590c6bf7472d2fb4acbb9e.jpg

Notification System
A new and experimental notification system makes it's debut.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/4550398d5f231087103df0fb53758a1c739f15dc.jpg

Sound Controls
You can now individually adjust the volume of different sound types in the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/789b7bed6e16f946e3ceac1716d0c5736c91ee6e.png

Roles

Serial Killer
The Serial Killer has always felt like a less interesting version of the Cannibal. I'm reworking him with a focus on his need to kill.


 Notoriety resource has been replaced with Blood Lust.
 Begins the game with 5 Blood Lust, and loses 1 per night.
 If he ever reaches 0 Blood Lust he is removed from the game.
 Still strikes players with an unstoppable attack if he can predict who they are targeting.
 Now granted 1 Blood Lust for each successful kill.
 Now untargetable at night.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/ec4b3da7b0fcdcc355f900b6f8f27da582c8d2b9.jpg

Arsonist

 No longer ignites two players.
 Now ignites one player, and their targets.
 No longer has permanent defence.
 Now only protected from fire.

Night Owl

 Now only invites 3 players to her Moon Party

notes.title: Freezing Time
notes.content:
Night Phases
Night is now split into two distinct phases, Action and Resolution.

Action

 Time limited.
 Players may use their abilities.
Resolution

 Players may no longer use their abilities.
 Abilities have their effect in the following order:  Manipulation > Detection > Protection > Elimination.

This means there will no longer be ambiguity when deciding how abilities interact with each other.

Haven
Haven's outside area has been updated, now featuring a waterfall, ambient sounds and lighting.

Before
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/3d6c5699130b76966129af9fbe639a5ace44efef.jpg
After
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/8ca4e5484f3ca53b1752067d921da946c6d214e5.jpg

Locations
The Garden location has been reworked and is now called the Clearing.

Before
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/491be1ad653794c9eba216be75454fe707939977.jpg
After
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/1728010a5c4e20deef75463cf6926a50db1482eb.jpg

Mod Menu

 Added the ability to remove a player's role.
 Added the ability to end a game, revealing all roles.

Small Changes

 Added a skull to dead player's nametags.
 Slightly reduced the size of role cards (thanks fem!).
 You can now see revealed roles on the Home screen.
 Added several ambient sound effects.

Roles
The goal of this update is to make less popular roles more appealing, thematic, and easier to mod. To begin, the 'encased in ice' and 'fragile' keywords have been removed from the game, and all frost roles have been reworked.

Frost Mage

 Blizzard has been removed
 Encased in Ice has been reworked into Ice Block.
 New ability - Frost bolt
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/aaa515cb8b4f0dd2e16eb681e5bb5ea65f8795b9.jpg
Frost Wolf

 Encased in ice has been reworked into Frost Claws.
 New ultimate - Blizzard.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/5f204717a44f087e25722308d632c5bcb100293d.jpg
Frost Drake 

 A new Dragon has awoken from a century long slumber. (Thank you Gracie for the art!)
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/1f93531650455f7001885fd7339df1383328ed69.jpg

Additional Reworks
Dragon

 No longer lays in wait, unleashing an attack if lynched.
 No longer has Latent Heat as a resource.
 Now has a nightly 3 player wide blazing attack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/d48f5b93c2803ea05a5b3e65500188195ce34915.jpg
Dragon Knight

 Now Lesser Evil.
 Now leaves attackers ignited.
 Now redirects attacks from a player onto himself.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/7ec66ae130fb709d377397e268d8eacea2067992.jpg
Plague Doctor

 Plague is now permanent.
 Plague is now only spread to the players targeting a player with plague.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/76faffcc91eb2d6222139afdcdb16f03fa52e50e.jpg
Ringmaster

 Now Neutral.
 Now causes a single player to roll the dice of death, with it having a random effect.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/a36b75c054f441bd26b2c8ad700619f8ea2993e8.jpg
Starving Wolf

 No longer causes the Werewolves to not be able to eliminate for a night on death.
 Now causes all Werewolves to only be able to attack their neighbours.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/ef8e3f8271e92b939246e7b52417d465a2f1fec0.jpg
Weresheep

 No longer makes players appear as Sheep.
 Now turns a player into a Sheep (1 charge).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/c7d52286dc446bdde07fd664df380cd86355a2e1.jpg
Werwolf Horror

 No longer called the Werewolf Horror, now just the Horror.
 No longer forbids words.
 Now scares all targets off of a player.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/36c61b314c649100a0f4133ee8fca926c3f4ebdf.jpg

Balance Changes
Death

 Death's Divine Protection proc now costs 2 souls instead of 1.

Dracula

 No longer has permanent defense.
 Converted players no longer learn who dracula is.
 Dracula no longer learns the role of converted players.

Healer

 Now uses mana.
 Gains 50 mana per night.
 Heal costs 25 mana.

Juggernaut

 No longer stands guard at a player's house.
 Now has a devastating 3 player wide attack (1 charge).

Justice

 Can no longer get justice on players that survive attacks, now only accusations.

Locksmith

 No longer roleblocks his target.

Tormenter

 No longer role blocks players.
 Now causes a player to target her instead of their original target/s.

Necromancer

 Removed.

Wolf Cub

 No longer grows up into a Werewolf of his choice.
 Now grants the Werewolves an additional attack on death.

notes.title: Role Sets
notes.content:
Sets

 Added support for additional official and community role sets.
 Added official Starter Set.


Roles

 Added Medium
 Added Druid


UI

 Added red tint to selected menu title.


Tavern

 Improved lighting.
 Opened up a new path outside.


Mod Menu

 You can now set houses to unclaimed, allowing them to be claimed again.
 Added passives to ability stacks.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug causing your mic volume to reset to 100% every time you open your menu.
 Fixed a bug causing in house lighting error and fallback to dynamic lighting, eating performance.

notes.title: Hearing Things
notes.content:
Tavern

 It's cold in here. Has someone left the front door open?


UI Sound Effects

 Added several sound effects to the user interface. 


Player Houses

 You can now enter player houses regardless if they are claimed or not.
 You now only see your role once the game begins.


Voice Chat

 Globally increased the volume of all voice chat by 1.5x.


Bug Fixes

 Fixed a bug causing your menu to close when pressing spacebar after clicking to view a role.
 Fixed issues with player collision.
 Fixed an issue causing nametags to not always render.
 Fixed a bug causing your voice to stop transmitting if you close your menu.


Roles

Den Mother

 No longer redirects attacks on other Werewolves to herself. 
 Can now protect a player at night (but never herself)


Dragon Knight

 Now part of Dragon Group.
 Now Neutral.
 Now has permanent defense.
 Now redirects attacks on his target to himself.


Death

 Now gains 1 soul when another player dies.
 Now denies all role reveals.
 Is no longer untargetable at night.
 Now gains Divine Protection if fated to die at the cost of 1 soul.
 Can now strike a player with an unstoppable attack at the cost of 2 souls.

notes.title: Seeing Things
notes.content:
Targeting

 Multi target abilities now track how many targets you have and display current target count compared to expected target count.
 Players selected whilst targeting are now highlighted in your faciton's colour.
 Abilities now consider target restrictions when targeting.

Curent Restrictions

 Can I target alive/dead players
 Can I target myself 
 Can I target a player on consecutive nights
 Can I target more than once per game
Future Retrictions

 Players affected by a certain ability
 Players of a certain faction/class/role group


Mod Menu

 Permanent and persistent abilities are now shown to the moderator. 
 A random role assignment button has been added allowing the moderator to assign a random role to a selected house (or random house if no player is selected).


Nametags

 Fixed a bug causing nametags to now always show up.
 Added a player's house number to their nametag if they own a house.
 Added a star to the moderator's nametag.
 Increased the size of the talking border to make it more obvious when a player is speaking.
 Added a roleout animation that animates the player's name appearing once they are close enough.
 Nametags are now occluded when a player is behind an object.


Haven

 Closed off both sides of the area outside to players alive in the game
 Added a cave outside


Player Character

 Removed bra from female player model when not naked.
 You can now leave your house at night if dead.


Voice Chat

 Extended the range at which players can hear you


New Role Art

 Fire Mage
 Hag
 Seer
 Justice
 Mirror Fiend
 Cannibal

notes.title: Passion
notes.content:
Locations
The 3 existing locations have undergone a major overhaul, now boasting new visuals and themes. The locations system has also been upgraded to allow for new locations in the future.

Throne Room
A large and elaborate structure intended for larger groups that focus on a single player, such as the Royals or Cult.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/08dc97bebfac1cdcb35f800179a4a6f6c5fb5b35.png

Cellar
A dark and intimate space intended for two players with an undertone of danger, such as the Jailer or Information Broker.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/f6293e5dc903d1079dfda3f5c1f116740924822e.png

Garden
A beautiful and open garden intended for larger groups in a relaxed and (mostly) friendly environment, such as for a Moon Party.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/81681d67c2893a60509b4b0aa0586f24d580cc84.png

Player Houses
Players may no longer leave their houses at night and now respawn at home.

Sessions
Sessions have been upgraded to allow for Steam invites and joining on friends via your friends list.
Additionally sessions now have join permissions, specficially:

 Invite Only - Only players invited via steam can join.
 Friends - Only friends can join.
 Public - Anyone can join.

User Interface
The user interface has been redesigned and rebuilt with a focus on simplicity and functionality. Notably the icons on the Nav Bar have been replaced with titles to improve readability.

Home
A new screen providing an overview of the session that you are currently in. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/44ac38b3653f4fd64cb3b01ad33791326c8c8c1c.jpg

Worlds
Browse existing sessions or create your own for other players to join.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/a7b4ef35c12c2e28cac8f37d485bafe817f96294.jpg

Roles
A new layout with improved filtering and a new on-hover element showing the hovered role's faction.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/ed61045ba7b1a41db562d45f9d9d1604a6dde962.jpg

Role Details
A new role details screen with a simplified design.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/9a09a038b92589a7d6a6ddaf1442d5efd8c0e795.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/0fbe1536d46e6ebde03686e2e0726aaf1b670b95.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/78533b9830a8912ad0e5f751dab6130c22d2f2fe.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/d9f67f0645bb527e0c58712808179c45058f4d83.jpg

Nametags
Nametags have been heavily optimized and you no longer see your own nametag, additionally your nametag no longer dims when crouching.

Targeting
Targeting has been redesigned and is now included in a new role panel that provides all the information about your role at the bottom of your screen.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/4f06eccf2c52e04d1975d194888c4fec84b5f51b.jpg

Mod Menu
Finally, the new mod menu makes a debut. Whilst still a work in progress it completely replaces the old menu with new features such as random role asignment, resource control, and teleporting to locations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/bb81f995452e9b160e477edb3779727b6cf9056a.jpg

Worlds
The stonemasons are at it again!

Tavern
The cellar has opened up, but it seems to be flooded?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/31f70f4380ab1f46092cf4de908dfcd8376e506a.png

Haven
Haven has been opened up and now has a mote, cliff faces, and a market outside!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/51a039c3a2ca3bb7938920f10f90cf2aee104b34.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/9165f98c091fa6d62006b46e84a861ae1a2cb868.png

Roles

Role Groups
A new and optional attribute that groups certain roles together. There are currently two role groups, Royals and Dragons

 Royals - A privileged circle of influential figures who meet in secret each night, their elevated status granting them unique insights and actions that shape the course of the game.
 Dragons - A powerful conclave who meet under the veil of night, their combined strength and ancient wisdom a force to be reckoned with.

New Art

 Alpha Wolf
 Dracula
 Frost Mage
 Princess

New Roles

Cupid

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/58067e3c1df6b524b08a77fa7073c75c3a394a7b.jpg

Magistrate

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41791307/f88c4e420e2603a11650dd41d9d7c976a921deaa.jpg

Role Changes

Arsonist
Firey Retaliation (permanent defense) now ignites attackers.

Assassin
Now always untargetable at night

Baby Dragon
Now removes 1 player if killed during day
	
Bard
Serenade charges 3 -> 2

Corrupt Noble
No longer assumes the role of the evil player he meets with.
Now meets with the Werewolves if there are no Evil players alive.

Council Elder
No longer changes player's faction to neutral
Now adds a player to the council each night, meets with the council at night.
Now wins when anyone part of the council wins.

Cow
No longer turns a player into a cow on death.
Now causes poison to spread to a random player each night

Creep
Now learns his neighbours classes instead of roles.
No longer reveals his identity to Evils/Werewolves that he stalks.

Dark Seer
Learnt role is no longer shared with evils and werewolves.

Death
No longer gets divine protection if fated to die, is now untargetable at night.
No longer marks players for death making them exposed.
Now automatically harvest's a player's soul on lynch, denying their role reveal
Now wins after harvesting 3 player's souls.

Dracula
Now only learns a player's role if they are Town

Dragon Knight
Is now Town
No longer becomes a dragon if attacked
Now kills his attacker if killed.

Fire Dragon
Cataclysm now kills one player per two latent heat
	
Frost Mage
Blizzard no longer ultimate, now costs 60 mana

Guardian Angel
No longer protects herself alongside her target with divine protection, but can now target herself.

Greenhorn
No longer reveals a player's role on death.
Now has permanent defense.

Juggernaut
Now kills anyone who visits his target.

Old Man
Attacks are no longer always unstoppable, he is now permanently exposed
Can no longer alert at night, now attacks a player twice if lynched. 

Ringmaster
Loser no longer dies, is now forcibly accused.

Tormenter
No longer enhances evil players.
Now roleblocks, regardless of faction.

notes.title: Welcome Home
notes.content:
A New Home

Player houses have undergone intense renovation, boasting a brand new interior featuring themed entrances for the cave, royal chamber, cellar and back garden.

Interaction System

The interaction system has been redesigned to allow for interactable objects to have multiple functions. 

This new system is now being used for player house doors, allowing the house to be claimed or entered, however this system can be expanded to allow for player voting in the future.

The interaction system has also been heavily optimized, more specifically it only checks for objects that are interactable and does so once every few miliseconds instead of on each frame.

Roles
New Role Art

Corrupt Noble
Council Elder
Creep
Dark Seer
Magus
Plague Doctor
Royal Knight
Skeletal Wolf
Wolf Girl

Dracula

No Longer attacks a player at night.
Now learns the role of his target and turns them into a lesser evil if they are town.

notes.title: Still Falling
notes.content:
Mod Menu

House UI now displays a player's faction.
You can now filter faction and class whilst assigning roles.

Bug Fixes

Fixed voice chat indicator not working as a Moderator.

Gameplay

Poison, Bleed and Ignite can now be protected from on the night that they are applied.

Roles
Witch

Renamed to Sorceress

Blood mage

Corpse Explosion is now an Unstoppable attack.

Impersonator

No longer learns role and targets.
Now copies a player's role but remains lesser evil.

Alpha Wolf

Now changes a player's faction to Werewolf if he is the last Werewolf alive.

New Role Art

Bard
Courier
Extortionist
Information Broker
Necromancer
Soothesayer
Sorceress

notes.title: Fall
notes.content:
User Interface

Added a welcome message to welcome new players.
You can now hover over roles in the role menu to preview them.
Added an animation when hovering over roles in the roles menu.
Added a shiny new Mod Menu and HUD.

Bug Fixes

You no longer get stuck when trying to navigate windows and other objects. 
Rogue gloves are no longer locked.

Gameplay

Players can no longer leave their house at night. (Looking at you Gracie)

Roles
Baby Dragon

Dragon Scales (Permanent Defense) - Removed.
No longer activates the Dragon's ability on death.
Now meets with all alive Dragons.
Now grows up to become a Dragon of their choice if they survive an accusation.

Bard

Serenade now has 3 charges.
Spectacle Reworked - Now permanently enhances a player instead of enhancing the entire town.

Blood Fiend

Now has permanent defense.

Blood Mage

Sacrifice (Divine Protection) - Removed.

Council Elder

No longer adds players to a council that performs a special accusation before announcements.
Now adds two players to a secret council. Their factions are changed to neutral and the council meets at night.

Cow

No longer poisons a random player that caused the Cow's death.
Now chooses a player to turn into a cow.

Creep

No longer shares information with Werewolves and Evils.
Werewolves and Evils now learn the Creeps identity if he attempts to stalk them.

Cult Leader

Indoctrinate now has 2 charges.
The cult now ONLY win with the cult leader.
Cult members now die if the Cult Leader dies.

Den Mother

No longer provides all Werewolves with permanent defense.
No longer gains an additional attack if another Werewolf dies.
Now redirects all nightly attacks on other Werewolves to herself.

Fire Dragon

New ability - Breathe Fire - Ignite a player's house.

Dragon Knight

Now has permanent defense.
No longer becomes the Fire Dragon if he kills two players.
Now becomes a Dragon of his choice if he survives an attack.
No longer kills the attacker of his protected target.

Fallen Star

Shine Bright (1 Persistent Charge of Divine Protection) - Removed.

Grave Digger

Must now exhume a player to win.

Greenhorn

No longer bleeds a target after sacrifice.
Now reveals a player of his choice after sacrifice.

Information Broker

Changed from Lesser Evil to Neutral
No longer causes two players to meet and share information at night.
Now causes roles to not be revealed on death, however he learns the role of any dead players.
Now meets with a player each night.

Inquisitor

Commonality is no longer announced, it is rather shared privately with the Inquisitor.

Old Man

Changed from Neutral to Town.
No longer redirects abilities used on him to his neighbours.
Now stands alert and shoots anyone who visits him at night (1 Charge).

Sectator

No longer converts the Werewolves' attack to a Werewolf if they are the last Werewolf alive.
Now changes a player's faction to Lesser Evil (1 Charge).

Soothsayer

Soothe no longer causes both players to die if they are both alive at the end of the day.
Soothe now forces both soothed players into accusation.

Tree

No longer causes abilities used on neighbours to be used on the Tree.
Now has permanent defense.

Wolf Cub

No longer grants an additional Werewolf attack on death.

Zombie

Changed from Lesser Evil to Evil.
No longer groans.
Bite now causes player's to become Zombified on death.

notes.title: Return of the King
notes.content:
Voice Chat

Player volume control now persists after closing your menu.
Globally increased voice chat volume.

Tavern

Opened up the kitchen.
Began renovations upstairs

Haven

Opened up the main gate, allowing for private conversations during the day.
Added furniture to all houses.
Added a role card to the interior of all houses.

Locations

Added locations to the game, allowing for players to secretly meet at night.

Roles
Added

King
Tracker
Storm Mage
Arsonist

Removed

Spy
Forger

Frost Mage

Encase in ice no longer leaves the player fragile. Now blocks a single attack, but causes any other attacks during the night to become unstoppable.
Frost Bolt - removed
Conjure Blizzard - now an ultimate.

Frost Wolf

Encase in Ice - removed.
Ice Claws - removed.
Conjure Blizzard - removed.
 New ability - Frost Bolt. Encase a player in ice and then attack them.

Extortionist

No longer extorts a player into getting another player accused. Now extorts a player into getting themselves accused.

Night Owl

No longer shares passive during Moon Party.
Now chooses who to to invite to her Moon party.

Juggernaut

No longer has massive 3-player wide bleeding attack. Now stands guard at a player's house, attacking anyone who tries to kill them.

Royal Knight

Now always attacks with a bleeding attack, regardless if they can eliminate.

Mirrorfiend

Now longer grants a shield that redirects attacks and lynches. Now grants Divine Protection.

Shield Maiden

New ability - Rönd. Protect a player for the night.
Shield wall is now an ultimate.

Locksmith

No longer roleblocks when protecting.

Prophet

No longer receives a random prophecy each night. Now chooses a capability and learns the closest player sharing that capability.

Dracula

No longer marries players.
New ability - Immortality. Permanent defense.
New ability - Drink Blood. Attack a player.

Dragon Knight

Now Neutral.
Amount of kills required to become the Dragon reduced from 2 to 1.

Chupacabra

Now attacks with an unstoppable attack when all Werewolves are dead.

Vigilante

Is no longer removed from the game they shoot a Townsfolk.
Shooting no longer reveals your role.

Priest

Throwing holy water no longer reveals your role. (And the moderator will no longer say anything if your holy water has no effect.)

Fire Mage

Flame Shield no longer automatically protects against lynches. Must now be used for 25 mana to grant the you Divine Protection.

Faceless

No longer shares fate with copied player.
Must now copy a player's role on first night.

Jailer

No longer role blocks jailed players.
No longer stops makes jailed player untargetable.
No longer dies if executes a Townsfolk.
Now protects jailed player.

Queen

Now Neutral
Now only wins if she is the ONLY Royal left alive at the end of the game.

Sentry

No longer creates a 5 player wide protection zone. Now divides the town in two, protecting from any attacks made from one side to the other.

Serial Killer

No longer appears as Town.
Now wins when they have more kills than there are players alive in the game.

Pantsu Wolf

Renamed to Pants Wolf

Party Animal

No longer dazes the player he is partying with.

Magus

No longer redirects lynches.
Now only protects 1 player.
Attacks are now always redirected.

Cannibal

Now learns the role of any players that they devour.

Werecat

No appears as town.

Weresheep

No longer appears as sheep.
Can now make an additional player appear as sheep. 

Necromancer

New ability - Shadow Bold. Attack a player.
No longer turns players into zombies each night. Now causes any players who die to remain in the game in a zombified state.
Meets with all zombified players each night.

notes.title: Sleep Tight
notes.content:
Voice Chat

Adjusted the way that sound attenuates. Voices should now more naturally decrease in volume with distance to other players.
Greatly increased the range at which you can hear other players.
Your character's mouth now moves when you speak in game.
Fixed a bug causing voice chat to not initialize on the first time you open the game.

Tavern

You can now interact with the book at the top of the stairs to open the Roles Menu.
Adjusted the lighting, making the Tavern slightly brighter.

Roles
Fallen Star

Now gains 2 Star Dust each night, instead of 1.
Shine Bright - No longer grants Divine Protection whenever attacked, now grants the Fallen Star a single, persistant charge of Divine Protection.
Sleep Tight - You are no longer rewarded with Star Dust when protecting another player.
Don't Fight - Cost increased from 2 to 3 Star Dust. Is now an unstoppable attack and no longer grants Star Dust for eliminating a player capable of elimination.
Win condition changed from 'You win when you have 10 Star Dust' to 'You win when no other players are capable of elimination.

Princess

Can no longer overturn a vote if she is accused.

Fire Mage

Fireball mana cost increased from 25 to 50

Jailer

Split the Jailer's ability up into two abilities (Interrogate, and then execute) to make it easier to read and understand.
Now makes his interrogated target untargetable to other players.
Can no longer choose to protect the interrogated target, only eliminate. (target is effectively protected as they are untargetable.)

notes.title: Expression
notes.content:
Voice Chat

Implemented a new and shiny Voice Chat system.
You can now select input device and input volume.
Future features will include:

Per-player volume control.
'Dead chat' allowing dead players to chat without disrupting the game.
'Moderator chat' allowing the hosts to communicate in secret. 

Animations

Overhauled the character animation system.
Implemented blend spaces, allowing animations to blend together.
Made the transition between idling and running much smoother.
Added directional running and sneaking animations.
Your character will now look up and down as you move your mouse.

notes.title: Targeting 1.1
notes.content:
Targeting

You can no longer target during the setup phase.
Majorly improved the responsiveness of the targeting UI.
Targets are now larger, making it less likely they'll be missed.


Movement

Reduced the player's collision by 25%, this should help with the 'bumping'. (Thanks sondaar!)
Reworked jump velocity and gravity, making jumps feel a lot less floaty.


Tavern

Opened up the balcony and main bedroom.


Mod Menu

Dead players are now greyed out.
Role history now stores when the player dies.
Added ability tooltips.
The mod can now add targets onto houses.

notes.title: Obsession
notes.content:
Targeting 1.0

Added night targeting, allowing players to target other players with their abilities at night.
There are currently 5 types of abilities:

On the first night abilities, such as the Guardian Angel's bind, which will only allow the player to target on the first night.
Each Night abilities, such as the Bodyguard's protect, which have no cost and can be used once per night.
Abilities with a certain amount of charges, such as the Shield Maiden's protect, that can be used a certain amount of times per game.
Abilities that cost resources, such as the Fire Mage's fireball, that require the player to have enough of a certain resource to use the ability.
Ultimates, such as the Chronomancer's paradox, which can only be used once per game.
Permanent effects are carried over to the next day, where as non permanent effects can always be viewed via target history.
Targeting currently decides 'Can I target' for a player. Deciding based on your ability's type, if it costs anything, your resources, if you've already used it, etc to decide if you can use the ability.
In the future targeting will also take into account 'Who can I target'. Restricting available targets to valid/allowed targets. For example the grave digger should only ever target dead players, and the bodyguard should not be able to target himself.


Roles 

Drunk, Jester and Lord have all been removed from the game.
Psychopath 

Now grants himself and his obsession permanent defense.
No longer collects blood to paint masterpieces.
Has a new resource, rage.
Each player that visits his obsession generates 1 rage.
Daytime elimination of a player that previously visited your obsession will cause you to lose 1 rage.
If he reaches max rage (5) he will kill his obsession target, and himself, losing the game.
He now wins the game if his obsession and himself are the only players left alive.

Blood Mage 

No longer gains blood charges when people die.
Has a new ability, drain, which allows him to leave a player bleeding and gain a blood charge each night.

Dragon 

No longer gains Dragon Fire whenever attacked at night.
Now passively gains 1 Dragon Fire each night.
Cataclysm now kills players equal to the Dragon's Dragon Fire

Royal Guard 

Can no longer reveal himself to save a Royal's life during the day.
Now grants Divine Protection instead of a basic protection.

Council Elder 

The Council no longer perform a special acusation phase before announcements, they now vote to spare or eliminate the Council Elder's acusation target without discussion.

Jailer 

Is now no longer revealed if they execute a Townsfolk.

Wolf Girl 

No longer sees who her target visits at night. Reverted back to learning her target's capabilities. (Thanks Elder!)

Werewolf Scholar 

No longer learns his target's capabilities, now learns his target's role instead.

Spy 

No longer asks the moderator if a question they posed during the day was answered truthfully.
Now appears to investigation as the faction that investigates him, and learns the identity of the player who investigated him.
Can now poison anyone, but only once per game.

notes.title: Vivid Memories
notes.content:
Modding

Added role history, allowing the moderator to view the game state of any previous night.
Started to lay the foundations of targeting.


Roles 
Death 

No longer immune to attacks, is now granted Divine Protection if fated to die (at the cost of a soul)
Now permanently marks players as exposed when marking them.
Now denies the role reveal of marked players that die.
No longer wins with 3 souls, now uses souls as a resource to survive.

Plague Doctor 

Is now unaffected by poison and plague.


Character Customization

Fixed female hair colour defaulting to brown on each map load. (Thanks lia!)
The Warrior, Rogue, Hunter and Mage sets are now available to everyone and are no longer purchasable.
Added beard customization option for male characers.


Tavern

Candles now play a sound when you ignite or extinguish them.
Added more spawners to facilitate large groups of players loading into the tavern at once.


Players Screen (Tab)

Redesigned the Players Screen from the ground up.
The players screen now displays:

The name of the map.
The current Day and Phase
Who the moderators are
Homeless players
A players list showing who owns which house, and their role if revealed.The server host, and any moderators can now make other plays moderators in the players screen.

Misc

Added the ability to respawn, defaulting to 'K'.
Main menu keybind changed to 'Esc' by default instead of 'Q'.
You will now always enter the cave facing forward.

notes.title: A Tavern Appears!
notes.content:
[ Main Menu ]

 Added a Tavern as the new main menu.
 You can now light the fire places in the Tavern.
 You can now open the chests in the Tavern to open your character equipment.
 The tavern is now hosted as an online session.


[ Online Sessions ]

 Steam friends can now join your session using the friends list.
 You can now invite friends to your session.
 The session owner can now change map, with all connected players travelling to the new map.


[ Misc ]

 Added volumetric fog to all maps.
 Added trees to the Debug map.


[ Nametags ]

 Improved nametag rendering.
 Added blur effect to nametags.
 Added green glow to nametags to indicate when a player is speaking.

notes.title: Its Wednesday My Dudes
notes.content:
[ Sky ]

 Replaced complex simulated volumetric clouds with a 2D cloud skybox. 
 Clouds now randomize at the start of every in game day.
 Adjusted the colour of the sky to better match the stylized game style.
 Built a custom Werewolf sky system that allows for control over the different day phases. (The very first step of targetting!)


[ Lighting ]

 Rebuilt the lighting system from the ground up.
 Replaced a moving 'Sun' dynamic light with 3 static light positions for Day, Dusk and Night. (This vastly improves performance and allows for better lighting whilst appearing exactly the same in game.)
 Replaced a dynamic sky light that would react to the sky's ambient lighting with 3 static and pre-baked sky lights (baked for the 3 day phases). Vastly improving performance and lighting quality.
 Brightened up dusk and the evening to help with visibility and to better match the game's style.


[ Main Menu ]

 Removed empty box disguised as a castle.
 Built a brand new Tavern!
 The intention is for the Tavern to be a 'staging ground' for groups to get together before they move to a game map to play. (This will be added next update)
 The tavern is not fully furnished and has loads of areas that will open up in the future.

notes.title: Who said what?
notes.content:
[ Voice Chat ]

 Players will no longer be able to hear their neighbours at night. (crazy)
 Increased the voice chat falloff distance so that you can hear other players from further away.


[ UI ]

 Added a mic icon to the HUD to show when you are speaking.
 Added a glow effect to nametags to show when another player is speaking.

 Optimized the roles menu to search and filter instantly.
 Added filter options for Faction and Class
